title: IMPRINT Reels
subtitle: for UBC IMPRINT
summary: A run of reels for UBC Imprint Conference & Competition, where I'm VP Content Marketing. The first two tease After Hours on 20 October 2026. More land over the next few weeks.

body.heading: The brief
body.text: Make people want to show up to After Hours without telling them much about it. The first rule of After Hours, as the caption says, you already know.

body.heading: The reel
body.text: Shot and cut as a short film teaser, opening on a title card that reads “a film by Ilyas Ishenaliev”. Red type, dark rooms, two people who clearly know something you don't.

body.heading: What's next
body.text: New episodes are on the way. They get added here as they're posted.
